properties.title: Work with data relations in QGIS - Core functionalities and plugins
properties.description:
It's about relations in QGIS and how they are edited in the attribute form with widgets in general, as well as some plugins that override the relations editor widget to improve usability and solve specific use cases

How do you work with relations in QGIS? In this workshop we will give an introduction on the different forms of simple or more complex data relations.
We will look how they are managed in QGIS and how they are configured and edited in the attribute form with widgets. We will have a closer look at cardinalities and relation strengths etc.
Furthermore, we will go into some QGIS plugins that override the relations editor widget to provide a better user experience and solve specific use cases.


##### Requirements for the Attendees
* QGIS 3.28 or later.
